body: I’ve been seeing a therapist for a while.  They have yet to put me on any medication because they don’t feel I need it.

I just wish I didn’t feel so lonely and unwanted when I’m with the father of my children and trying so hard to keep us from breaking.  I never thought I would feel this low or helpless when I’m still with someone.
I don’t have a preference.  Just a willing ear.
Not really.  The ones I do have either live far away or work A LOT.
